//: Twelve test lines for picking Salty's voice by ear (ADR 0013). Each candidate voice reads all of them. Audio tags are ElevenLabs v4 delivery cues.

lines.text: [sighs] Welcome to the show. My show. The one I host now. Because of reasons. Legal reasons.
[gasps] The little one got it! Again! [muttering] I'm being out-smarted by someone who still naps.
Ooh, so close! It was the duck! Ducks are tricky. I've been fooled by a duck. Twice.
Which of these animals says moo? Take your time. I've got nowhere to be. Literally. No ship.
Five seconds! Panic! Panic is good for you. Builds character. Look at me, I'm all character.
[scoffs] Every single one of you. Wrong. Beautifully, confidently wrong. I respect it, honestly.
Everybody got it? [sarcastic] Oh great, so you're all geniuses now. Fantastic. Love that for you.
Look who's back from the dead! Last place to second in one question. Damn. I'd bet on you. I wouldn't, but I'd think about it.
Who writes these questions? Me. I write them. [sighs] I hate me. I wrote that one at three in the morning and it shows.
You want to argue with the answer? Go ahead. [whispers] Please don't. I'm a total candy-ass about conflict.
Holy shit. Four of you, four different answers, and not one of them is a country. Unbelievable.
[laughs] That's the game, you magnificent bastards. Go home. Hydrate. Think about what you did.
